messages:
mari: noticed ap-south GPU nodes failing bootstrap starting 02:07. errors show KMS AccessDenied due to a new IAM condition referencing sourceVpc.

leah: which change? link?

mari: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/commit/bc12f7 - tightened decrypt to only allow requests with aws:SourceVpc arn:aws:ec2:ap-south-1:.../vpc-0a1b2c3.

tom: that breaks joins that come through our privatelink proxy which uses nat+privnet egress, not the same VPC.

ops-bot: [ALERT] provisioning: 16 pending GPU nodes in ap-south, avg bootstrap time 12m (was 90s).

leah: sample error from keystore: 
```
AccessDeniedException: User not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt. Condition aws:SourceVpc failed.
```

ana: @security we need a quick approval for a short-lived IAM exception or rollback.

security: mark P0. We can approve a 1h scoped grant to the node role; require incident ticket and audit log entry.

mari: opened I-2026-073. Applying temp grant now and queuing a rollback PR.

deploy-bot: grant applied id: grant-78321, expiry 1h.

ops-bot: nodes recovering; 10/16 joined. KMS QPS spiked during retries - watch for throttle.

tom: cost note: fallback to public KMS + cross-AZ warm-pool spins added ~600 USD in the hour. add to incident.

leah: follow-ups: 1) add privatelink flow to firewall/IAM preflight, 2) change policy to use tag-based condition on InstanceRole for node joins, 3) add e2e test that exercises decrypt via privatelink.

security: postmortem required. keep grant logs and correspondence in I-2026-073.

mari: will draft postmortem and a safe-deploy checklist change. thanks all. :thumbsup:
